global_experience.layout: Content sits in a centred column up to about 1200px wide with comfortable side margins. The header and the hero background may span the full width.
global_experience.look: Style, tone, accent and fonts come from the brief's look. Text is real text laid over images, never part of an image.
global_experience.header: The site name on the left, anchor links in the middle or right, and one call-to-action button. On phones the links collapse behind a menu button.
global_experience.feedback: Every action gives visible feedback: a button shows it is working, errors sit next to the field, and success replaces the form.
global_experience.empty_states: Anything without content shows a neutral, labelled placeholder, never a broken image or empty box.
global_experience.owner_area_naming: Names in the owner area match the names of the blocks on the page, so an owner can find what they see.

pages.purpose: Make the promise clear and get the visitor to join the waitlist.
pages.sections: The blocks from the brief in order. Default order: hero, preview, benefits, waitlist, footer.

states.loading: The page is server-rendered, so there is no loading state.
states.submitting: The form button shows progress and cannot be pressed twice.
states.success: The form is replaced by the thank-you message from the brief. A reload shows the form again.
states.error: A message under the field with the problem, or a general message if the server is unreachable, keeping what the visitor typed.

pages.purpose: Tell the visitor the page does not exist and offer a way home.
pages.sections: A short message and a link to the home page.
Email, password, sign-in button. After a failed attempt the email stays in the field.

pages.purpose: Show how the experiment is going.
pages.sections: Summary (total, today, progress to goal), breakdown by each select question, breakdown by source, the list with search, delete and CSV download.
